news.titleEn: Nvidia prepares to oust Jensen Huang, WSJ reports — stock sinks
news.conclusionEn: Nvidia's board is preparing to remove CEO Jensen Huang and could decide as soon as Wednesday, sending the stock down more than 9% after hours.
news.conclusionZh: 英伟达董事会据报准备罢免黄仁勋，盘后股价跌超9%
news.whyEn: Nvidia is the world's most valuable chipmaker and the bellwether of the AI trade; a sudden leadership change could jolt global tech stocks and index funds.
news.whyZh: 英伟达是AI行情风向标，CEO突然更替可能冲击全球科技股和指数基金
news.detailEn: The Wall Street Journal reported the board may meet as soon as Wednesday to decide Huang's future. The move follows reports of two extramarital relationships, including one with a woman U.S. intelligence believes is a Chinese spy, and another with an Nvidia executive. The board has opened an independent investigation and hired law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz. The after-hours drop also pulled Nasdaq 100 futures lower, erasing part of Wednesday's tech rally.
news.detailZh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，董事会最快周三开会决定黄仁勋去留。此前媒体曝出他有两段婚外情，其中一名女子被美国情报部门怀疑是中国间谍，另一人是英伟达高管。董事会已启动独立调查，并聘请律所Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz介入。盘后暴跌还拖累纳指100期货走低，抹去周三科技股的部分涨幅。

news.titleEn: Fed's Goolsbee calls inflation report 'borderline disturbing' as central bank weighs more hikes
news.conclusionEn: After October CPI rose 0.4%, Fed officials including Goolsbee, Waller and Logan signaled more rate hikes, with Waller floating a half-point move in December.
news.conclusionZh: 10月CPI超预期，多位美联储官员暗示12月继续加息
news.whyEn: Markets now fully price a December hike; higher U.S. rates strengthen the dollar and raise borrowing costs worldwide, including mortgages and business loans.
news.whyZh: 市场已完全押注12月加息，美元走强，全球房贷和企业融资成本承压
news.detailEn: Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee described the latest inflation data as "borderline disturbing," noting it was the third straight month of hot readings. Governor Christopher Waller suggested a 50-basis-point hike could be warranted, while Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan backed two more quarter-point increases. The Fed's target range is currently 3.75%-4% after a September hike. Futures show near-certain odds of a December hike and about 15% odds of a half-point move.
news.detailZh: 芝加哥联储主席古尔斯比称最新通胀数据「近乎令人不安」，这已是连续第三个月数据偏热。理事沃勒表示12月加息50个基点也可能合理，达拉斯联储主席洛根则支持再加息两次、每次25个基点。目前联邦基金利率区间为3.75%-4%，9月曾加息一次。期货市场显示12月加息几乎板上钉钉，加息50个基点的概率约15%。

news.titleEn: CoreWeave soars more than 24% for best day since April 2025 after strong Q3 report
news.conclusionEn: CoreWeave's Q3 revenue jumped 168% to $3.7 billion and it raised full-year guidance, sending its stock up nearly 25% and lifting the Nasdaq 1.6%.
news.conclusionZh: CoreWeave营收大增168%并上调指引，股价飙升近25%
news.whyEn: The results eased fears that AI infrastructure spending is slowing, reviving the broader AI trade across chipmakers and cloud providers.
news.whyZh: 缓解了市场对AI基建投资放缓的担忧，带动芯片和云服务股回暖
news.detailEn: CoreWeave beat analyst expectations of $3.55 billion in revenue and now guides for $13 billion to $13.3 billion in 2026 revenue. CEO Michael Intrator said demand for AI infrastructure "is and remains overwhelming." The stock had slumped in recent weeks on concerns about its heavy debt load. Its rally helped the S&P 500 gain 1.3% on Wednesday, though Nvidia's leadership turmoil hit futures after the close.
news.detailZh: CoreWeave第三季度营收超过分析师预期的35.5亿美元，并将2026年营收指引上调至130亿至133亿美元。CEO Michael Intrator表示AI基础设施需求「依然极其旺盛」。该股此前几周因债务负担沉重的担忧大幅下跌。其大涨帮助标普500周三上涨1.3%，但收盘后英伟达的管理层风波又拖累了期货。

news.titleEn: Oil rises from two-month low as Hormuz shipping attacks offset Iran truce hopes
news.conclusionEn: Oil rebounded from two-month lows as new tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz offset hopes of a U.S.-Iran de-escalation.
news.conclusionZh: 霍尔木兹海峡油轮再遭袭击，油价从两个月低点反弹
news.whyEn: Hormuz carries a large share of global oil supply; swings in Brent feed directly into fuel costs and inflation, which the Fed is now fighting.
news.whyZh: 霍尔木兹是全球石油要道，油价波动直接影响燃油成本和通胀
news.detailEn: Brent crude rose to around $92-93 a barrel after Iran's Revolutionary Guards said two more tankers struck mines in the strait. October saw 37 ships attacked in and around the waterway, the most since the war began. Prices had fallen sharply earlier in the week after U.S. officials played down further strikes on Iran. Analysts say even a deal would not quickly restore flows, given mine clearance, insurance costs and shipowner caution.
news.detailZh: 伊朗革命卫队称又有两艘油轮在海峡触雷后，布伦特原油升至每桶约92至93美元。10月共有37艘船只在该水道及周边遭袭，为开战以来最多。本周早些时候，美国官员淡化对伊朗进一步打击的必要性，油价曾大幅下跌。分析师指出，即使达成协议，扫雷、保险成本和船东顾虑也会让航运难以迅速恢复。

news.titleEn: CNBC/NRF Retail Monitor data for October 2026
news.conclusionEn: U.S. retail sales rose just 0.2% in October, the slowest monthly growth in nearly a year, as high prices strained consumers.
news.conclusionZh: 美国10月零售额仅增0.2%，为近一年最慢增速
news.whyEn: A cooling consumer alongside hot inflation raises stagflation worries and complicates the Fed's hiking path ahead of the holiday season.
news.whyZh: 消费降温叠加通胀偏热，加剧滞胀担忧，也让美联储加息更两难
news.detailEn: Total retail spending reached $561.7 billion in October on a seasonally adjusted basis, up 3.6% from a year earlier. The monthly gain was the weakest since November 2025, and the NRF said Halloween and early holiday promotions kept it from being even lower. Furniture and home furnishings sales fell 0.2%, hurt by a frozen housing market as mortgage rates climbed. The data suggest shoppers are becoming choosier heading into the key holiday period.
news.detailZh: 经季节调整后，10月零售支出总额为5617亿美元，同比增长3.6%。环比增幅为2025年11月以来最低，美国零售联合会称万圣节和提前开始的节日促销才使数据没有更差。由于房贷利率上升、楼市冻结，家具和家居用品销售下降0.2%。数据显示，进入关键的节日购物季前，消费者正变得更加精打细算。

news.titleEn: European Stocks Set for Record as Miners and Tech Rally
news.conclusionEn: Europe's Stoxx 600 rose about 0.7% to an all-time high as miners and tech shares rallied on lower oil prices and renewed AI enthusiasm.
news.conclusionZh: 欧洲斯托克600指数涨约0.7%，创历史新高
news.whyEn: Record highs in Europe show investors rotating into non-U.S. markets even as Fed hike risks rise, which matters for global portfolio allocation.
news.whyZh: 在美联储加息风险上升时欧股创新高，显示资金正在向美国以外市场轮动
news.detailEn: Germany's DAX gained more than 1%, while the UK's FTSE 100 and France's CAC 40 each rose roughly 0.7%. Miners and technology stocks led the advance, helped by weaker oil prices earlier in the session and a rebound in AI-linked shares. European equities have repeatedly hit records this year as investors diversify away from U.S. assets. The Nvidia news after the European close could test that momentum on Thursday.
news.detailZh: 德国DAX指数上涨超过1%，英国富时100和法国CAC 40各涨约0.7%。矿业和科技股领涨，受益于盘中油价走低和AI相关股票反弹。今年以来，随着投资者分散配置、减少美国资产，欧股屡创新高。欧洲收盘后传出的英伟达消息，可能在周四考验这一涨势。

news.titleEn: US Treasury chief Bessent moved to military base after 'Iranian threats'
news.conclusionEn: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has been moved from his Washington home to a military base after Iranian threats against his life.
news.conclusionZh: 因遭伊朗威胁，美财长贝森特被转移至军事基地居住
news.whyEn: Bessent leads the sanctions campaign against Iran; the threats show the war's risks spilling onto Western soil and could harden U.S. policy.
news.whyZh: 贝森特主导对伊制裁，此事显示冲突风险外溢到西方本土，美方立场或更强硬
news.detailEn: A senior official said threats against Bessent had reached "more than an advanced stage." He has led Operation Economic Outcast, the U.S. sanctions and pressure campaign aimed at forcing Iran to stop attacking shipping and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Secretary of State Marco Rubio and chief of staff Stephen Miller have also reportedly relocated to protected housing in recent weeks. Treasury said Bessent will not be deterred and will keep up the blockade.
news.detailZh: 一名高级官员称，针对贝森特的威胁已「超过高级阶段」。他自8月起主导名为「经济弃儿行动」的对伊制裁与施压，目的是迫使伊朗停止袭击船只、重新开放霍尔木兹海峡。据报道，国务卿鲁比奥和白宫幕僚长米勒近几周也已搬入受保护住所。财政部表示，贝森特不会被吓倒，将继续执行封锁。

news.titleEn: Millions of Spaniards stage first general strike in 14 years as anger rages over housing
news.conclusionEn: Millions of Spanish workers joined a 24-hour general strike over housing costs and wages, the country's first in 14 years.
news.conclusionZh: 西班牙爆发14年来首次大罢工，抗议房价和工资问题
news.whyEn: The strike puts housing affordability at the center of Spain's Nov. 29 snap election and highlights a housing crunch shared by many developed economies.
news.whyZh: 住房问题成为11月29日大选焦点，也折射出多个发达经济体共同的住房危机
news.detailEn: Spain's two largest unions, CCOO and UGT, called the walkout under the slogan "wages, housing, prices," and said about four million workers took part. Transport, schools and healthcare were disrupted across the country. The Bank of Spain estimates the country is 750,000 homes short, with average rents now roughly equal to a young person's average salary. The protests were sparked by the eviction of an 87-year-old woman in Madrid in September.
news.detailZh: 西班牙两大工会CCOO和UGT以「工资、住房、物价」为口号发起罢工，称约400万名工人参与。全国交通、学校和医疗服务受到影响。西班牙央行估计全国住房缺口达75万套，目前平均房租几乎等于年轻人的平均工资。这波抗议源于9月马德里一名87岁老人被强制驱逐。

news.titleEn: 'Climate crisis is outrunning us,' UN chief Guterres says at COP31
news.conclusionEn: At the COP31 leaders' summit in Turkey, UN chief Guterres warned the world is on a path to "mutually assured destruction" and urged a phase-out of fossil fuels.
news.conclusionZh: 古特雷斯在COP31警告气候危机正「跑赢」人类，呼吁淘汰化石燃料
news.whyEn: COP31 outcomes shape future energy policy, climate finance and carbon rules that affect energy companies, investors and emerging economies.
news.whyZh: COP31结果将影响能源政策、气候融资和碳规则，关系到能源企业和投资者
news.detailEn: Guterres said emissions hit record highs in 2025 and that the last four years were the hottest on record. He accused the fossil fuel lobby of delaying action, saying current national plans still put the world on track for more than 2.5C of warming by 2100. His speech opened two days of addresses by world leaders in Antalya. Several major leaders are absent, which may limit how ambitious any final agreement can be.
news.detailZh: 古特雷斯表示，2025年排放量创历史新高，过去四年是有记录以来最热的四年。他指责化石燃料游说集团拖延行动，并称即使各国现有计划全部落实，到2100年全球仍将升温超过2.5°C。他的演讲拉开了世界领导人在安塔利亚为期两天的发言。多位主要国家领导人缺席，可能限制最终协议的力度。

businessTips.explanationEn: Tone at the top describes the ethical culture set by a company's leaders through their own behavior, not just written policies. Employees take their cues from what executives actually do, so a leader's lapses quickly erode trust and compliance across the organization. Boards and investors treat it as a core governance risk because a scandal at the top can damage reputation, talent retention and valuation all at once.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「高层基调」指企业领导者通过自身行为（而不只是书面制度）所塑造的道德文化。员工会看高管实际怎么做，所以领导者一旦失范，整个组织的信任和合规意识都会迅速瓦解。董事会和投资者把它视为核心治理风险，因为高层丑闻可能同时损害声誉、人才留存和公司估值。
businessTips.exampleEn: Reports that Nvidia's board may remove Jensen Huang over personal conduct show how leadership behavior can become a company-wide issue. Even a small business owner who skips the rules they set for staff will find those rules quietly ignored.
businessTips.exampleZh: 英伟达董事会可能因个人行为问题罢免黄仁勋，说明领导者的行为可以演变成整个公司的问题。小店老板也一样：自己不遵守给员工定的规矩，这些规矩很快就会形同虚设。

businessTips.explanationEn: Profit First is a cash-management method that flips the usual formula from Sales - Expenses = Profit to Sales - Profit = Expenses. Each time money comes in, you move a fixed percentage into separate accounts for profit, owner pay and tax before spending on anything else. This forces you to run the business on what's left, which exposes waste early and keeps a side hustle from silently losing money.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「利润优先」是一种现金管理方法，把常见公式「收入 - 支出 = 利润」改成「收入 - 利润 = 支出」。每笔收入到账后，先按固定比例转入利润、自己的工资和税款等独立账户，剩下的钱才用于开支。这会逼你用剩余资金经营，尽早发现浪费，避免副业在不知不觉中亏钱。
businessTips.exampleEn: A freelancer earning $3,000 a month could move 10% to a profit account, 15% to a tax account and 40% to owner pay, then run the business on the remaining 35%. If expenses keep exceeding that 35%, it's a clear sign to cut tools or raise prices.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位月入3000美元的自由职业者，可以先把10%转入利润账户、15%转入税款账户、40%作为自己的工资，再用剩下的35%经营业务。如果开支总是超过这35%，就说明该砍掉一些工具或提价了。

businessTips.explanationEn: Backlog, often reported as remaining performance obligations (RPO), is the value of signed contracts a company has not yet delivered or recognized as revenue. It gives investors visibility into future sales beyond the current quarter's guidance. However, backlog only turns into revenue if the company can actually deliver, and contracts may be concentrated in a few customers or stretched over many years.
businessTips.explanationZh: 积压订单（财报中常以「剩余履约义务」RPO披露）指公司已签约、但尚未交付或尚未确认为收入的合同金额。它能让投资者看到当季指引之外的未来收入。但积压订单只有在公司真正交付后才会变成收入，而且合同可能集中在少数客户身上，或分摊到很多年。
businessTips.exampleEn: AI cloud providers like CoreWeave report backlogs many times their annual revenue, which helps explain why investors cheered its latest results. A smart investor also checks how fast backlog converts to revenue, who the biggest customers are, and whether the company has the capacity and financing to deliver.
businessTips.exampleZh: 像CoreWeave这样的AI云服务商，积压订单往往是年营收的好几倍，这也是投资者对其最新财报欢呼的原因之一。聪明的投资者还会看积压订单转化为收入的速度、最大客户是谁，以及公司是否有足够的产能和资金来完成交付。
